spans.s:
Pacata, like pakti, denotes ‘cooked food’ in the Rigveda and later.
Foot notes i. 61, 7; x. 116, 8.
Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, xxi. 60; xxiii. 13; kauṣītaki brāhmaṇa, viii. 21, etc.

Pacana in the Rigveda and the Śatapatha Brāhamaṇa denotes a ‘vessel for cooking’ food.
Foot notes i. 162, 6.
vi. 5, 43, 3. 4; xiv. 1, 2, 21.
